topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text: Found a scrap o' parchment in my partner's chest today, hid 'neath the linens and worn shoes. On it was writ a list, not of chores or debts, but of wild things—riddles and quests, like seein' the sea or speakin' with the king himself. I muse on the pauper's reach, dreamin' so far as the horizon and beyond. It's a strange thing to hold, a map of wishes not said aloud, not shared 'round the fire. I worry what it means to keep such a thing to oneself, what it speaks of a heart that dreams quietly. I feel a pull to speak of it, yet I fear the breaking of somethin' silent and sacred. Best to tend the fields, as is my due, and ponder these matters in the stillness of the night.
